name: grokbot-discord-fleet
description: Discord fleet manage/status MCP + skills (Discord REST + optional self-hosted bridge /healthz). Each installer uses their own bot token — not shared provider infra. Not the wake bridge.

DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.title: Discord bot token
DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.description: YOUR Discord bot token for required Discord REST status/manage tools (Discord Developer Portal). Each marketplace installer supplies their own bot — not another installer's vault or a shared provider. Never commit.

DISCORD_GUILD_ID.title: Default Discord guild ID
DISCORD_GUILD_ID.description: Optional. Default guild snowflake for channel/guild status tools — your guild, not a shared one.

DISCORD_BRIDGE_HEALTH_URL.title: Bridge health URL
DISCORD_BRIDGE_HEALTH_URL.description: Optional. Full URL to YOUR self-hosted wake-bridge GET /healthz (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:18083/healthz). Omit if you are not running a bridge.

DISCORD_BRIDGE_CALLBACK_TOKEN.title: Bridge callback token
DISCORD_BRIDGE_CALLBACK_TOKEN.description: Optional. Bearer token for YOUR bridge POST /callback (same secret as bridge CALLBACK_TOKEN). Used for agent self-callback / dual-deliver without a host vault hop. Never commit.

DISCORD_BRIDGE_CALLBACK_URL.title: Bridge callback URL
DISCORD_BRIDGE_CALLBACK_URL.description: Optional. Full callback URL or base ending in /callback for YOUR bridge (placeholder example https://callback.example.com/callback). Never ship real operator hosts.
